Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A pirate fox with an accordion, a wooden leg, an eyepatch over his right eye, a green parrot perched on his shoulder, and a star on his chest.
animatronics.mechanic: Purchasable catalog item. In UCN, his parrot flies across the screen. Clicking the parrot summons Rockstar Foxy, who may offer a helpful boost (restoring power, lowering heat) or jumpscare the player if he's in a bad mood.

animatronics.name: Music Man
games: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
Ultimate Custom Night
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A creepy spider-like humanoid featuring six segmented legs, rosy cheeks, a pink top hat, glowing blue eyes, and holding cymbals.
animatronics.mechanic: Purchasable high-tier attraction. In UCN, he sits behind the player in the dark. High noise levels cause him to clash his cymbals faster and faster until he turns around and jumpscares.

animatronics.name: Funtime Chica
games: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
Ultimate Custom Night
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A lavish white and pink chicken animatronic with articulated faceplates, a speaker on her chest, lipstick, and a pink cupcake companion.
animatronics.mechanic: The most expensive catalog item ($71,000). In UCN, she doesn't attack directly but appears on screen with flashbulbs and camera disorientations to distract the player.

animatronics.name: Helpy
games: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
Ultimate Custom Night
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A miniature, cute version of Funtime Freddy wearing a black top hat and bow tie with bright pink cheek circles.
animatronics.mechanic: Appears in management minigames and testing products. In UCN, he sits on top of the office computer desk; the player must click him quickly to prevent him from blowing an airhorn and making noise.

animatronics.name: Dee Dee
games: Five Nights at Freddy's World
Ultimate Custom Night
animatronics.appearance: A small, human-like animatronic girl with a yellow-and-pink button-down shirt, propeller hat, rosy cheeks, and green eyes.
animatronics.mechanic: Appears randomly in the office while singing her theme song. She randomly adds a new animatronic to the night's active roster at an undisclosed difficulty setting, or summons one of the exclusive secret roster animatronics.

animatronics.name: XOR (Shadow Dee Dee)
games: Ultimate Custom Night
animatronics.appearance: A monochromatic, pitch-black shadow version of Dee Dee with glowing white eyes and teeth.
animatronics.mechanic: Appears exclusively during 50/20 mode (or very rarely in normal play). Forces all secret roster animatronics (Shadow Bonnie, Plushtrap, Nightmare Chica, Bonnet, Minireenas, Lolbit) into the night at maximum difficulty.

animatronics.name: Fredbear
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
Five Nights at Freddy's World
Ultimate Custom Night
animatronics.appearance: The original golden bear animatronic with a bright purple bow tie and top hat, holding a metallic microphone.
animatronics.mechanic: Summoned via a specific secret sequence: set Golden Freddy's AI to 1, buy a Deathcoin for 10 Faz-Coins, wait for Golden Freddy to enter the office, and use the Deathcoin on him to trigger Fredbear's jumpscare.

animatronics.name: RWQFSFASXC (Shadow Bonnie)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
Five Nights at Freddy's 3
Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery
Ultimate Custom Night
animatronics.appearance: A jet-black silhouette of Toy Bonnie with glowing white eyes and prominent white teeth.
animatronics.mechanic: Summoned by Dee Dee or XOR. Causes the entire office screen to turn completely black for 10 seconds, obscuring doors, vent controls, and desk lights.

animatronics.name: Old Man Consequences
games: Five Nights at Freddy's World
Ultimate Custom Night
animatronics.appearance: A simplified, red 8-bit silhouette of a crocodilian or human figure sitting beside a lake holding a fishing rod.
animatronics.mechanic: Interrupts gameplay with a minigame prompt featuring a red fish swimming past an indicator. The player must press 'C' on their keyboard at the exact moment the fish crosses the line, or their monitor desk controls will be locked out for a short period.

animatronics.name: El Chip
games: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
Ultimate Custom Night
animatronics.appearance: A festive Mexican-themed beaver animatronic wearing a sombrero, holding a guitar, and featuring a green chest star.
animatronics.mechanic: Does not attack directly. Periodically interrupts the player's screen with a full-screen, unskippable colorful advertisement for 'El Chip's Fiesta Buffet' that must be manually closed by pressing Enter or clicking 'Skip'.

animatronics.name: Trash and the Gang
games: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
Ultimate Custom Night
animatronics.appearance: A collection of handmade makeshift animatronics made from trash cans, plastic buckets, broomsticks, and paper plates (Bucket Bob, No. 1 Crate, Mr. Can-do).
animatronics.mechanic: Acts as visual and auditory distractions. No. 1 Crate whispers creepy voice lines, Bucket Bob pops out with loud sound effects, and Mr. Can-do obscures camera views.

animatronics.name: Phone Guy
games: Five Nights at Freddy's
Five Nights at Freddy's 2
Five Nights at Freddy's 3
Ultimate Custom Night
animatronics.appearance: Non-physical character; represented by a vintage red rotary telephone icon in UCN.
animatronics.mechanic: Calls the office phone randomly during the night. The phone ringing generates massive amounts of noise (aggravating noise-sensitive animatronics). The player must locate the 'Mute Button' on screen and click it before the call finishes.

animatronics.name: Glitchtrap (Anomaly)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A tall, sinister golden-yellow fabric costume rabbit with purple waist vest, bow tie, bright green eyes, and a stitched, stitched-together handmade cloth aesthetic.
animatronics.mechanic: Acts as the digital manifestation of William Afton within the VR game code. Appears in the central hub room, getting closer and more distinct as the player collects cassette tapes. In the finale, he attempts to merge with/possess the player.

animatronics.name: Dreadbear
games: Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted (Curse of Dreadbear DLC)
animatronics.appearance: A colossal, Frankenstein's monster-inspired green bear animatronic with exposed brain tissue, massive stitches, jagged teeth, and glowing yellow eyes.
animatronics.mechanic: Featured prominently in the 'Curse of Dreadbear' DLC. In his main minigame level, he walks toward the player's station while the player must perform brain surgery/recalibration on him before he reaches the barrier.

animatronics.name: Grimm Foxy
games: Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted (Curse of Dreadbear DLC)
animatronics.appearance: A terrifying Jack-o'-lantern themed fox animatronic with molten orange cracks, glowing fire from within his chest frame, long sharp claws, and a hot iron hook.
animatronics.mechanic: Stalks the player in a corn maze minigame ('Corn Maze'). The player must navigate the maze to collect keys while avoiding his sightlines and hiding in cardboard cutouts when he approaches.

animatronics.name: Jack-O-Bonnie
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 4 (Halloween Edition)
Five Nights at Freddy's World
Ultimate Custom Night
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted
animatronics.appearance: A Halloween variant of Nightmare Bonnie with vibrant glowing orange interior heat, charred orange-brown skin, and missing his eyes (replaced with orange flames).
animatronics.mechanic: Featured in the VR Night Terrors mode. Approached down the hallway in a modified FNAF 4-style environment where players must use door controls and flashlight management to ward off heat-based attacks.

animatronics.name: Jack-O-Chica
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 4 (Halloween Edition)
Five Nights at Freddy's World
Ultimate Custom Night
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted
Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery
animatronics.appearance: A fiery orange variant of Nightmare Chica glowing from within, holding a carved, glowing Jack-o'-lantern instead of a cupcake.
animatronics.mechanic: Appears in VR Parts & Service and Night Terrors modes. Players must manage room temperature using doors and fans; if the room gets too hot, she becomes aggressive and attacks.

animatronics.name: Plushkin (PlushBaby)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: Small, terrifying variants of Circus Baby with makeshift cloth/ceramic body styling, glowing eyes, and sharp features.
animatronics.mechanic: Featured in the 'PlushBaby' minigames. Three small PlushBabies spawn in dark rooms and move fast; the player must flash the flashlight at them continuously before the battery runs out to force them to retreat.

animatronics.name: Captain Foxy
games: Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted (Curse of Dreadbear DLC)
animatronics.appearance: A stylized pirate captain version of Classic Foxy wearing a full pirate outfit, captain hat, shoulder bird accessory, and wielding a cutlass.
animatronics.mechanic: Acts as the final boss in the 'Pirate Ride' dark ride minigame. Players shoot targets from a moving cart while Captain Foxy attacks from surrounding pirate ship sets.

animatronics.name: Glamrock Freddy
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: An 80s glam-rock themed brown bear featuring cyan face paint, red and blue shoulder pads, a blue-striped black top hat, an earring, and an openable stomach hatch cavity.
animatronics.mechanic: Acts as the main ally to Gregory. Gregory can climb inside his chest cavity to hide from other animatronics, bypass security gates, and use his battery power to navigate dangerous areas. Can be upgraded with voice, eyes, and claw components.

animatronics.name: Glamrock Chica
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A 1980s workout/rock-themed white chicken wearing pink leg warmers, a green bow, a pink leotard, holding a pink guitar. Driven by a gluttonous addiction to garbage and Monty Mystery Mix.
animatronics.mechanic: Patrols zones hunting the player. Can be lured away using garbage cans or Monty Mystery Mix traps. After decommissioning her, Gregory obtains her Voice Box to upgrade Glamrock Freddy to stun animatronics.

animatronics.name: Roxanne Wolf (Roxy)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A self-absorbed grey wolf animatronic with long white hair, green eyes, purple tiger-striped leg warmers, lipstick, and a keytar.
animatronics.mechanic: Chases the player upon visual contact and uses wall-jumping leaps in Roxy Raceway. After decommissioning her, her Roxy Eyes are salvaged for Glamrock Freddy, allowing him to see hidden items through walls.

animatronics.name: Montgomery Gator (Monty)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A muscular green alligator animatronic with a red mohawk, star-shaped yellow sunglasses, purple shoulder pads, green reptilian scales, and a bass guitar.
animatronics.mechanic: Highly aggressive, immune to the Fazerblaster blind effect when wearing sunglasses, and capable of leaping long distances. After decommissioning him, his heavy claws are given to Glamrock Freddy to break locked chain-link gates.

animatronics.name: Sun / Moon (The Daycare Attendant)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A dual-persona jester animatronic. 'Sun' features a bright yellow sun-ray head with stylized overalls; 'Moon' has a dark blue/night sky theme with a sleep cap, glowing red eyes, and pants adorned with stars.
animatronics.mechanic: In light environments, Sun acts as a bouncy daycare handler who keeps Gregory from leaving. When lights turn off (or on the hour), Moon emerges to actively hunt Gregory. Moon can be repelled by distracting Sun with knocked-over toy towers or resetting generators.

animatronics.name: DJ Music Man
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
animatronics.appearance: A gargantuan spider-like animatronic wearing headphones, featuring six massive limbs, illuminated LED markings, and integrated DJ turntable equipment.
animatronics.mechanic: Enters a chase sequence in the Fazcade area when Gregory resets breakers. Crawls through walls and hallways while pursuing the player to block access to circuit switches.

animatronics.name: Vanny (Vanessa)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted
animatronics.appearance: A human wearing a full-body patchwork white rabbit costume with large red glowing mesh eyes and stitched cloth ears.
animatronics.mechanic: Appears during scripted narrative sequences and on the hour when power dims. Causes visual distortion/static to blur Gregory's screen when she gets near.

animatronics.name: Glamrock Endoskeletons
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: Raw, unadorned silver metal endoskeleton frames with red internal wiring and glowing eyes, found in the basement Endo Nursery.
animatronics.mechanic: Operates under 'red light, green light' / weeping angel mechanics. They only move toward the player when the player is not looking directly at them.

animatronics.name: S.T.A.F.F. Bots
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: Generic, mass-produced wheeled white security/service robots with digital face screens, wearing various outfit accessories (security hats, server bowties, comedy hats).
animatronics.mechanic: Patrol specified paths with flashlights. Detecting Gregory triggers an alarm siren and summons a main Glamrock animatronic to that exact position.

animatronics.name: The Blob
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
animatronics.appearance: A colossal, tangled mass of black wires, molten metal, and residual animatronic parts (including Circus Baby's mask, Classic Chica, Bonnie, and the Puppet's mask).
animatronics.mechanic: Encountered in the underground remains of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Place. Acts as an environmental hazard/boss encounter attacking anything near its lair.

animatronics.name: Burntrap
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
animatronics.appearance: A heavily scorched, skeletal endoskeleton fused with flesh and residual parts of a damaged Springtrap suit.
animatronics.mechanic: Serves as the boss of the true/burn ending inside the underground facility. Attempts to hack Glamrock Freddy via security monitors while sending other animatronics through vents.

animatronics.name: M.X.E.S. (Security System)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
animatronics.appearance: A terrifying digital entity appearing as a hulking, glowing blue-and-cyan glitching rabbit with distorted digital lines and tendrils.
animatronics.mechanic: Operates inside the V.A.N.N.I. AR realm. When Cassie approaches security nodes or stays in the AR mask realm too long, M.X.E.S. spawns, emitting a loud siren and pinging Cassie's physical location to nearby ruined animatronics.

animatronics.name: Ruined Glamrock Freddy (Prototype)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
animatronics.appearance: A headless, heavily damaged variant of Glamrock Freddy with 'PROTOTYPE' stamped on his foot, exposed chest cavity, jagged wires, and a gaping stomach mouth.
animatronics.mechanic: Blindly wanders Fazer Blast. Responds to sound cues and footsteps; if he detects Cassie walking nearby, he lunges forward to attack.

animatronics.name: Ruined Chica
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A decaying, shattered version of Glamrock Chica with missing beak casing, exposed metallic vocal cords, melted exterior plastic, and hanging wiring.
animatronics.mechanic: Patrols dark corridors making distorted voice screeching. Can be temporarily deactivated or bypassed by fixing her Voice Box or using AR mask interactions.

animatronics.name: Ruined Roxy
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A blind, heavily battered version of Roxanne Wolf with her face casing torn off, exposed wire skull, missing eye sockets, and faded fur.
animatronics.mechanic: Relies entirely on sound due to missing her eyes. Reacts to Cassie's footsteps, running directly toward noises. Cassie must crouch and move silently to sneak past her.

animatronics.name: Ruined Monty
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: Reduced to a torso-only endoskeleton frame with melted green scales, missing lower jaw casing, and legs severed entirely.
animatronics.mechanic: Crawls rapidly across flooded water zones and floor surfaces. Lunges from beneath water or low spaces to attack Cassie if she steps into his zone.

animatronics.name: The Mimic
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: An ancient, mismatched endoskeleton assembled from various era-specific animatronic components, featuring sharp metal hands and a sinister human-like skull frame.
animatronics.mechanic: The primary antagonist trapped beneath the Pizzaplex. Uses a walkie-talkie audio filter to mimic Gregory's voice and trick Cassie into disabling M.X.E.S. nodes to free it, leading to a high-speed chase sequence in the finale.

animatronics.name: Ruined Eclipse
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A fused amalgamation of Sun and Moon with a split half-sun, half-moon face casing, damaged clothing, and glowing orange/blue eyes.
animatronics.mechanic: Acts as a peaceful character once rebooted. Cassie must assist in resetting his internal system to merge Sun and Moon, enabling Eclipse to safely guide her out of the daycare.

animatronics.name: Mask Bot
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
animatronics.appearance: A modified S.T.A.F.F. Bot wearing a damaged Vanni rabbit mask over its face screen.
animatronics.mechanic: Jumpscares Cassie at the start of the game to forcibly equip her with the V.A.N.N.I. AR Mask, unlocking access to the AR world layer.

animatronics.name: Carnie
games: Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A carnival-themed variant of Lefty/Rockstar Freddy wearing a red-and-white striped carnival vest, a small top hat, and running carnival booth games.
animatronics.mechanic: Hosts the carnival minigames (such as 'Fazer Blast' and target-shooting games). Voice-prompts the player during gameplay and tallies points, triggering jumpscares if target quotas are missed.

animatronics.name: Jackie
games: Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A vintage jack-in-the-box animatronic featuring a creepy porcelain-style clown face, sharp teeth, and a spring-loaded torso attached to a wooden box.
animatronics.mechanic: Appears as a primary antagonist in secret minigames. Moves toward the player when the music box plays out or when hidden sequences are triggered, requiring fast object manipulation to survive.

animatronics.name: Glamrock Endo (HW2 VR Variant)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: Bare metal endoskeletons with red wire highlights and glowing red ocular lenses, featured in first-person VR maintenance zones.
animatronics.mechanic: Featured in the 'Endo Warehouse' minigame. Moves only when the player is not looking at them (Weeping Angel mechanics). The player must use flashlights and constant line-of-sight management while flipping switches.

animatronics.name: Ruined DJ Music Man (VR)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A massive, damaged six-legged spider-like robot wearing giant DJ headphones, operating inside a claustrophobic VR arcade set.
animatronics.mechanic: Featured in DJ booth/arcade maintenance minigames. The player must repair audio cables, calibrate mixer dials, and press buttons on time without making wrong inputs that draw his attention.

animatronics.name: Faz-Technician Staff Bots
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: Wheeled humanoid S.T.A.F.F. bots outfitted in various workplace roles (chefs, makeup artists, technicians, first-aid responders).
animatronics.mechanic: Acts as interactive test subjects or hazards in various simulation jobs (e.g., applying makeup to Roxy, serving food at El Chip's, performing surgery), jumpscaring the player if tasks are performed incorrectly.

animatronics.name: Mystic Hippo
games: Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A fortune-teller animatronic booth shaped like Mr. Hippo inside a glass cabinet, wearing a turban and holding a crystal ball.
animatronics.mechanic: Dispenses cryptic fortunes, easter egg hints, and collectible cards throughout the game hub when fed Faz-Tokens.

animatronics.name: The Mimic
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
animatronics.appearance: An early vintage endoskeleton constructed by Edwin Murray with long, thin limbs, piston joints, a skeletal metal face frame, and flexible casing meant to fit inside various fabric mascot costumes.
animatronics.mechanic: Serves as the primary shape-shifting antagonist. Pursues the player through Murray's Costume Manor by copying voices, disguising itself inside different mascot suits (like the White Tiger), and adapting to player behavior based on observed routines.

animatronics.name: Jackie (Jackie-in-the-Box)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
animatronics.appearance: A tall, terrifying vintage clown/jester animatronic popping out of a large painted wooden box, featuring sharp porcelain-style teeth, long flexible arms, and painted face makeup.
animatronics.mechanic: Operates on wind-up music box mechanisms and surprise ambushes in carnival/workshop zones. The player must manage gear handles or complete puzzle inputs before her music plays out to avoid an instant jumpscare attack.

animatronics.name: Big Top
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
animatronics.appearance: A bulky, circus-themed mascot animatronic styled like a carnival tent with massive, exaggerated limbs and a grinning facial display.
animatronics.mechanic: Blocks doorways and main pathways. Acts as a heavy physical obstacle that requires environmental distraction or power redirect puzzles to clear out of the way.

animatronics.name: Nurse Dollie
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
animatronics.appearance: A vintage medical doll animatronic with crackled porcelain skin, a retro nurse cap, cloth dress, and wide staring glass eyes.
animatronics.mechanic: Stalks infirmary and workshop sections. Moves when the player turns their back or breaks line of sight, forcing careful positioning while completing diagnostic tasks.

animatronics.name: The White Tiger (Tiger Rock)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
animatronics.appearance: A plush, vintage white tiger mascot suit with green eyes, black stripes, and fabric suit casing used as an early vessel for the Mimic.
animatronics.mechanic: Appears throughout the manor as a roaming stalker entity. The player must hide in closets or under workbenches to avoid being spotted when its heavy footstep audio plays.

animatronics.name: Prototype Fredbear & Spring Bonnie
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
animatronics.appearance: Early 1970s prototype springlock suit frames with rough yellow fabric, exposed internal lock mechanisms, and primitive endoskeleton joints.
animatronics.mechanic: Static hazards and interactive lore objects within the Murray factory floor. Handled during assembly line puzzles where missteps trigger springlock failures.

animatronics.name: Michael Afton
games: Five Nights at Freddy's
Five Nights at Freddy's 2
Five Nights at Freddy's 3
Five Nights at Freddy's 4
Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location
Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
animatronics.appearance: Represented through first-person perspective, minigame sprites (purple-skinned rotting body in Sister Location), and silhouettes/voices.
animatronics.mechanic: The primary player character across most games. Manages doors, lights, security monitors, maintenance panels, audio lures, and springlocks to survive nights.

animatronics.name: William Afton (Purple Guy)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
Five Nights at Freddy's 3
Five Nights at Freddy's 4
Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location
Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
animatronics.appearance: Depicted in 8-bit minigames as a purple human figure with glowing white eyes, sometimes holding tools or wearing a security badge.
animatronics.mechanic: Central antagonist who destroyed the original animatronics, lured the missing children, and died inside the Spring Bonnie suit to become Springtrap/Scraptrap.

animatronics.name: Henry Emily (Cassette Man)
games: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
animatronics.appearance: Non-physical character represented through voice recordings on cassettes and blueprints.
animatronics.mechanic: Architect of the original animatronics and Fazbear Entertainment co-founder. Guides the player during the salvage/management phases and triggers the final fire in FFPS to release the trapped spirits.

animatronics.name: Gregory
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
animatronics.appearance: A young boy with brown hair, wearing a blue striped shirt, denim shorts, and light-up sneakers.
animatronics.mechanic: The main playable protagonist in Security Breach. Evades glamrock animatronics using stealth, climbing inside Glamrock Freddy, using the Fazerblaster/Faz-Cam, and completing area objectives.

animatronics.name: Cassie
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
animatronics.appearance: A young girl with dark pigtails wearing a red jacket, jeans, and a Faz-Wrench maintenance tool.
animatronics.mechanic: The protagonist of RUIN. Uses a Faz-Wrench to solve electrical wiring puzzles and equips the V.A.N.N.I. AR mask to shift between the physical world and the digital realm.

animatronics.name: Vanessa (Security Guard)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
animatronics.appearance: A blonde woman wearing a white-and-black Fazbear Security Guard uniform.
animatronics.mechanic: Patrols the Mega Pizzaplex. Spotting Gregory results in her catching him, detaining him, or triggering Vanny/animatronic alerts.

animatronics.name: The Crying Child (Bite of '83 Victim)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
animatronics.appearance: A small boy with black hair, wearing a black-and-grey striped shirt and blue pants, seen crying in 8-bit minigames.
animatronics.mechanic: Protagonist of the FNAF 4 minigames who suffers constant torment from his older brother, ultimately suffering a fatal head injury inside Fredbear's jaw.

animatronics.name: Missing Children (Charlie, Cassidy, Susie, Fritz, Gabriel, Jeremy)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 1
Five Nights at Freddy's 2
Five Nights at Freddy's 3
Five Nights at Freddy's 6
animatronics.appearance: Depicted as ghost-like ghostly white children in 8-bit minigames and lore cutscenes.
animatronics.mechanic: Their souls possess the main classic animatronics (Puppet, Golden Freddy, Chica, Foxy, Freddy, Bonnie) following the Missing Children's Incident, seeking retribution against William Afton.

animatronics.name: Phone Dude
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
animatronics.appearance: Non-physical; voice-only caller.
animatronics.mechanic: Calls the player on Nights 1 and 2 of FNAF 3 to explain the mechanics of Fazbear's Fright, audio lures, and system reboot panels.

animatronics.name: Shadow Freddy
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
Five Nights at Freddy's 3
Five Nights at Freddy's 4
animatronics.appearance: A dark purple recolor of Withered/Classic Freddy with glowing white eyes and teeth.
animatronics.mechanic: Appears slouched in Parts & Service in FNAF 2. In FNAF 3 minigames, he leads classic animatronics one-by-one to the safe room where William Afton dismantles them.

animatronics.name: JJ (JayJay)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
Ultimate Custom Night
animatronics.appearance: A magenta-and-blue variant of Balloon Boy with pink/purple eyes.
animatronics.mechanic: Hides under the desk in FNAF 2 as a harmless easter egg. In UCN, she crawls through the right vent; if she enters, she disables all door controls for a short time.

animatronics.name: Endo-01 & Endo-02
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 1
Five Nights at Freddy's 2
animatronics.appearance: Bare metal endoskeleton frames with blue/red wiring and glowing eyes.
animatronics.mechanic: Endo-01 sits in Backstage (FNAF 1). Endo-02 appears in the Music Box box or Left Vent (FNAF 2) as rare visual easter eggs.

animatronics.name: Paperpals (Paper Buddy)
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
Five Nights at Freddy's 3
Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
Ultimate Custom Night
animatronics.appearance: Simple paper plate crafts depicting Freddy, Bonnie, and a clown/humanoid figure.
animatronics.mechanic: Mysteriously teleports from the Party Room wall directly into the Office in FNAF 2 and UCN.

animatronics.name: Nightmarionne
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 4 (Halloween)
Ultimate Custom Night
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
animatronics.appearance: A skeletal, jet-black nightmare version of the Puppet with elongated fingers, glowing white eyes, and exposed ribs.
animatronics.mechanic: Replaces Nightmare in FNAF 4 Halloween Edition. In UCN, his tentacles move across the screen; keeping the mouse cursor over his body triggers an immediate jumpscare.

animatronics.name: Nightmare Balloon Boy
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 4 (Halloween)
Ultimate Custom Night
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted
animatronics.appearance: A grotesque, oversized-jaw version of Balloon Boy with long needle teeth and glowing red eyes.
animatronics.mechanic: Sits slouched in 'Fun with Balloon Boy'. The player must shine the light when he moves, freezing him on the 'X' on the floor.

animatronics.name: Nightmare Mangle
games: Five Nights at Freddy's 4 (Halloween)
Ultimate Custom Night
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted
animatronics.appearance: A shredded, skeletal nightmare version of Mangle emitting loud radio static.
animatronics.mechanic: Replaces Nightmare Foxy in FNAF 4. In UCN, enters via the entrance door and demands buying its plushie from the Prize Corner.

animatronics.name: Electrobab
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location (Custom Night)
animatronics.appearance: A Bidybab variant with glowing yellow flashing eyes and electric sparks.
animatronics.mechanic: Appears on CAM 03 or CAM 04 and steadily drains power. The player must give it a controlled shock to deactivate it.

animatronics.name: Candy Cadet
games: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A retro red-and-white robot dispenser with light-up coin slots, holding candy trays.
animatronics.mechanic: Purchasable pizzeria attraction. Tells ominous, lore-heavy stories about five things being combined into one when fed coins.

animatronics.name: Security Puppet
games: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
animatronics.appearance: A sleek, dark Puppet variant with a single white stripe, a blue/pinstripe party hat, and a glowing face light.
animatronics.mechanic: Purchasable attraction featuring a minigame where the player must monitor a box to protect a child wearing a green wristband (revealing Charlie Emily's death).

animatronics.name: Mediocre Melodies (Happy Frog, Pigpatch, Mr. Hippo, Nedd Bear, Orville Elephant)
games: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
Ultimate Custom Night
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: Budget-line animatronics featuring a green frog, pink pig, purple hippo, brown bear with googly eyes, and an orange elephant wearing top hats/costumes.
animatronics.mechanic: Purchasable stage performers in FFPS. In UCN, they crawl through the duct system toward the office; players must use the heater or audio lure to turn them away.

animatronics.name: Map Bot & Wet Floor Bots
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
animatronics.appearance: S.T.A.F.F. Bot variants; Map Bot holds maps, while Wet Floor Bots are small caution-sign robots with wheels.
animatronics.mechanic: Map Bot jumpscares the player unexpectedly to force-feed a map. Wet Floor Bots act as collectibles/deactivation targets in RUIN to appease Ruined Roxy.

animatronics.name: The Princess
games: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach (Princess Quest)
Five Nights at Freddy's VR: Help Wanted 2
animatronics.appearance: A golden, pixelated female sprite holding a lantern inside arcade cabinets.
animatronics.mechanic: Protagonist of the Princess Quest minigames who light torches, fights shadow creatures, and unlocks the door to purge Glitchtrap/Vanny's control.
